measure.note_catalogue_releases: release entries in the catalogue (zero-byte hosting; records id + base only)
measure.note_mail_unread: unread letter count (read ones live in mail/read/)
measure.note_site_build: site builder selftest pass count (catalogue check + zero-byte gate both directions + determinism)
measure.note_specs_md: contract canon + evolution history document count (canon = v4)
measure.note_tool_check_release: release validator selftest pass count (V1-V10, one counter-case each)
measure.note_tool_manifest: manifest generator selftest pass count (allowlist negative + v4 shape + boundaries)
sitebuild.selftest_red: site build selftest red (rc=%(rc)d) — the zero-byte gate or the catalogue check failed
